{"bytes":303182,"code":200,"codeText":"OK","durationMs":8192,"result":"# CSS `scripting` Media Feature: Semantics and Coverage\n\n## What It Matches\n\nThe `scripting` media feature detects **whether scripting (such as JavaScript) is available** based on **browser user settings**. According to the documentation:\n\n> The detection is done by the browsers based on the user settings. Some browser extensions can implement script blocking using different techniques. In such cases the `scripting` media feature may not work as expected.\n\nThe feature has three possible values:\n\n| Value | Meaning |\n|-------|---------|\n| `none` | Scripting is completely unavailable on the current document |\n| `initial-only` | Scripting is enabled during initial page load, but not afterwards |\n| `enabled` | Scripting is supported and active on the current document |\n\n## Concrete Cases\n\n**`scripting: none` matches when:**\n- JavaScript is disabled in browser preferences/settings\n- *Potentially* when blocked by browser extensions (though reliability varies by extension method)\n\n**What it does NOT reliably detect:**\n- Scripts blocked by Content Security Policy (CSP) headers\n- Slow or pending script execution\n- Scripts blocked by specific extension techniques (noted as unreliable)\n\n## Example Usage\n\n```css\n@media (scripting: enabled) {\n  .script-enabled {\n    color: red;\n  }\n}\n\n@media (scripting: none) {\n  .script-none {\n    color: red;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Browser Compatibility\n\n**Status:** **Baseline Widely available** ✓\n\n- **Available since:** December 2023 across browsers\n- Well established and works across many devices and browser versions\n- Part of [Media Queries Level 5 specification](https://drafts.csswg.org/mediaqueries-5/#scripting)\n\n## Important Caveat\n\nThe documentation includes a crucial note:\n\n> Some browser extensions can implement script blocking using different techniques. In such cases the `scripting` media feature **may not work as expected**.\n\nThis means the feature is reliable for detecting browser preference settings but has limitations with extension-based blocking.","url":"https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/scripting"}
